svg.title: The parts of an action
svg.desc: The node drive_client on the left and the node drive_server on the right. Between them, the names under /drive_to_goal. Tag 1: three services, _action/send_goal, _action/cancel_goal and _action/get_result, each with an arrow from drive_client to it and from it to drive_server. Tag 2: two topics, _action/feedback and _action/status, each with an arrow from drive_server to it and from it to drive_client.
